answer: Give every account its own audit each epoch. A public beacon deals each one a different ledger excerpt with one planted error, such as a coin spent twice, and pay goes only to accounts that flag it by the deadline. Errors vary like needles on a juniper, so no shortcut rule finds them. Since no two excerpts match, one script cannot serve many names: a farm of N accounts must do N separate audits, so its cost climbs with every fake. Excerpts come from the vault of real unchecked ranges, so this oasis of honest work also hardens the ledger.
